def generate_signature(secret, body, timestamp):
    """
    Helper function to generate the HMAC signature for debugging.
    """
    if isinstance(body, str):
        body = body.encode('utf-8')
    timestamp = str(timestamp)  # Ensure timestamp is a string
    hmac_data = f"{body.decode('utf-8')}.{timestamp}".encode('utf-8")
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), hmac_data, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    print("DEBUG: Generated Signature:", signature)
    return signature
